label: Possibly, contingent concrete things are absent at a moment and present at a later one
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: some history accessible from the selected world has a moment at which no contingent concrete individual is present, strictly before a moment at which some contingent concrete individual is present. Contingent means existing in that history and absent from some world accessible from it. Nothing is said about the selected world itself, a first moment, a cause, or what else is present at the earlier moment.
